The campus budget risk calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a 1.00 mean reward across 1 trial with zero exceptions recorded in the harbor job info. Pytest version 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.314s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should verify edge cases in the weighting distribution to ensure the judge_reward of 0.73 is improved toward parity with the verifier.
